summary: The NSA's classified internal network is still being restored, and a US official says the patching is going slower than expected. Officials blame maintenance and a software patch. No official source reports a cyber attack. Markets are steady today and the FAA router problem is resolved.

events.title: NSA classified internal network (NSANet) still being restored
events.impact: The NSA closed its campus to most staff and kept essential staff only. A US official says patching is slower than expected. The NSA says mission-critical work continues.
events.stated_cause: NSA says scheduled routine maintenance. Officials also cite a software patch. No official source reports a cyber attack. The official would not give more detail.

events.title: Norway's Equinor reports a cyberattack on some IT systems
events.impact: Equinor said oil and gas output and operations are not affected and it sees no sign of stolen data. I found no newer update this run.
events.stated_cause: Equinor calls it a cyberattack. Who did it and how they got in are unknown.

events.title: Malicious code planted on sites using Optimizely tools
events.impact: Newsweek reported up to 178 organizations were hit. Optimizely says it removed the code and reset access. Real-world harm to visitors is unknown.
events.stated_cause: Optimizely says a weakness on its platform let attackers inject code. Who did it is unknown. Nothing links it to the other outages.

events.title: FAA nationwide ground stop; router installs paused
events.impact: The FAA paused Juniper router installs and turned off one function on more than 60 other routers. It is using older Cisco routers meanwhile. Congress is questioning officials today.
events.stated_cause: Officials say a new router flooded the network with data and overwhelmed older equipment. Duffy says the root cause is not yet known. HPE says its gear worked as configured.

events.title: S&P 500 fell a fourth day; mixed and steady today
events.impact: On Nov 17 the S&P 500 fell 1.03% to 7,340.53 and the Dow fell 1.64%. Today the S&P 500 is about flat and the Dow is down a few tenths of a percent. I saw no trading halts.
events.stated_cause: Reports cite AI stock worries, interest rates and Nvidia news. Nvidia's earnings beat gave a lift today. No exchange problem reported.

events.title: Bitcoin near 64K USD, down about 13% on the week
events.impact: Price data shows BTC around 63.7K to 64.2K, down about 1-2% in 24 hours. This is a slow slide, not a crash. I found no exchange outage.
events.stated_cause: Price sites give no single cause. Market notes point to Fed rate-hike talk.

events.title: Apple services (iCloud, Apple Pay, App Store) outage
events.impact: Thousands of outage-tracker reports. Apple said many systems were back up afterward.
events.stated_cause: Apple says an internal update caused it. Apple told Bloomberg it was not a cyberattack.

events.title: Chase banking services disrupted
events.impact: Some Chase customers could not use certain services on Monday. Chase looks operational now.
events.stated_cause: Chase says a software bug in an on-site hardware system caused it, and it is not cyber-related.

events.title: Marriott sign-in outage on website and Bonvoy app
events.impact: Some guests could not sign in or check in for a time. Marriott says it is fixed.
events.stated_cause: Marriott says a technical issue. Its review found no sign of a cyberattack.

events.title: Cloudflare shows degraded performance on its status page
events.impact: The status page lists degraded performance for some services. Recent incidents were minor and regional, mostly resolved within about an hour. I saw no wire report of a wide outage.
events.stated_cause: Cloudflare gives different causes for different issues. Cause of today's degradation is unknown.

events.title: AT&T user complaints on outage trackers
events.impact: Several hundred user reports on one tracker. No carrier statement or wire report seen. Looks like normal background noise.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. No carrier has given a cause.

events.title: Routine CISA notices on actively exploited flaws
events.impact: CISA keeps posting routine advisories and adding exploited bugs to its list. I saw no new Emergency Directive in the last 3 days.
events.stated_cause: Attackers exploiting software flaws. No notice links to the outages above.

connection_assessment.reasoning: FAA: a new router overloaded old gear, root cause still unknown. NSA: maintenance and a software patch, no detail given. Apple, Chase and Marriott each gave their own cause. Secretary Rubio said there is zero information linking them. No official source reports a cyber attack.
connection_assessment.would_change_my_mind: An official statement blaming the same company or attacker, or several big systems failing at the same moment, would make me think they are connected.

alert.reason: No new confirmed event links the incidents. The NSA network is still being restored but officials give a maintenance cause.

prep_note: No action needed for most people. Keep some cash and a charged phone handy. Check your flight status before you leave for the airport. Use official apps and websites, not links in messages, for any bank or travel updates.
